import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Remove exact duplicate rows (keep first occurrence, preserve penguin_id)
    df = df.drop_duplicates(keep='first').reset_index(drop=True)
    # Normalize species labels: strip spaces, fix typo
    df['species'] = df['species'].astype(str).str.strip()
    df['species'] = df['species'].replace({'Chinstarp': 'Chinstrap'})
    df['species'] = df['species'].where(df['species'].isin(['Adelie', 'Chinstrap', 'Gentoo']), other=pd.NA)
    # Fix negative flipper lengths (sign errors)
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = df['flipper_length_mm'].abs()
    df.loc[~df['flipper_length_mm'].between(170, 235), 'flipper_length_mm'] = pd.NA
    # Fix out-of-range body mass (value recorded in mg -> convert to grams)
    mask = df['body_mass_g'] > 6500
    df.loc[mask, 'body_mass_g'] = df.loc[mask, 'body_mass_g'] / 1000.0
    df.loc[~df['body_mass_g'].between(2500, 6500), 'body_mass_g'] = pd.NA
    # Sex: keep missing as unknown, do not guess
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].where(df['sex'].isin(['male', 'female']), other=pd.NA)
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    counts = df['island'].value_counts()
    return {island: int(counts[island]) for island in counts.index}
